title: The problem
text:
The problem
•
The actual dimensionality of the data manifold may be (and generally will 
be) greater than the dimensionality of z
•
Even if we capture the dimensionality of the principal manifold perfectly, 
there will almost always be some variation off it
– The actual distribution lies close to a curved manifold, but is nonetheless full-
dimensional
•
Our simple model captures none of the variation off the manifold!

text:

•
Assume that the actual data is obtained by adding noise to the output of the 
decoder

The noise accounts for the variation off the manifold

The model itself must be trained to minimize this noise

Ensuring that it has captured the principal manifold most effectively

decoder fully explains the distribution the training data

title: The actual model
text:
The actual model
•
The “decoder” is now actually a “generative” model for the data
– Has a “generative story” for how the data are produced
•
A -dimensional vector is drawn from a standard -dimensional 
Gaussian and passed through the decoder
– This results in data lying on a -dimensional non-linear surface in the data 
space
•
Then a full-rank, low-amplitude noise is added to it, to generate the final 
data 
– The actual data distribution is a fuzzy region around the surface.
